home.valueProp: Jaipur merchant export desk for EU gift and home décor importers.
bullets: v1: decorative blue pottery and brass gift décor from Jaipur makers
Default bulk term: FOB Mundra. We quote EXW, FCA, FAS, FOB, and CIF only
English documentation, written MOQ and lead time before production
EU decorative compliance path: GPSR and REACH with your importer partner
Prelaunch: building makers, QC, and export files. Not shipping yet

faq.q: Are you a factory or a trader?
faq.a: Merchant export desk. We curate Jaipur makers, align POs, packing, and export paperwork. You deal with one English speaking account.

faq.q: Can I buy food safe blue pottery for retail?
faq.a: Not in v1. We sell decorative ceramics only, labelled not for food use. Food contact needs a separate programme and EU 84/500 testing.
FOB Mundra for bulk LCL or FCL. Samples often EXW Jaipur. We do not quote DAP or DDP.
Strike offs or pre production samples with commercial invoice for customs. Revisions capped in writing before bulk PO.
Your EU importer acts as responsible economic operator. We supply product and test files we build with makers for decorative v1.

faq.q: Do you offer third party inspection?
faq.a: Yes when agreed on the PO. AQL table attached before production.

steps.title: After delivery
steps.body: Defect claim window with photos and carton marks. Reorder forecast for capacity.
